figurative_meaning_en: The only child in the family lineage
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কোনো ভাইবোন নেই, সে কুলের বাতি।
পরিবারের একমাত্র ছেলে হিসেবে সে কুলের বাতি।
example_sentences_in_english: He has no siblings; he is the lamp of his family.
As the only son in the family, he is the light of the lineage.
note: This idiom emphasizes the preciousness of a single child in traditional Bengali family structures.
